{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: GHC HEAD
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ci/ghc-head
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - ci/ghc-head
  workflow_dispatch:
  # pull_request: # comment out to have this run on PR's
  # runs at 8:00 on Mondays
# schedule:
           # ┌───────────── minute (0 - 59)
           # │ ┌───────────── hour (0 - 23)
           # │ │ ┌───────────── day of the month (1 - 31)
           # │ │ │ ┌───────────── month (1 - 12 or JAN-DEC)
           # │ │ │ │ ┌───────────── day of the week (0 - 6 or SUN-SAT)
           # │ │ │ │ │
           # │ │ │ │ │
           # │ │ │ │ │
           # * * * * *
  # - cron: '0 8 * * 1' # run weekly at 8 hour, https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/events-that-trigger-workflows#schedule
jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        # Checkout ci/ghc-head on scheduled runs, PR branch otherwise
        ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && 'ci/ghc-head' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
        submodules: true
    - name: Cache ghcup
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.ghcup
        key: ghcup-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('https://ghc.gitlab.haskell.org/ghcup-metadata/ghcup-nightlies-0.0.7.yaml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ghcup-${{ runner.os }}-
    - name: Install ghcup
      run: |
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://get-ghcup.haskell.org | sh
          ghcup install cabal latest
          ghcup set cabal latest
          ghcup --url-source https://ghc.gitlab.haskell.org/ghcup-metadata/ghcup-nightlies-0.0.7.yaml install ghc latest-nightly
          ghcup --url-source https://ghc.gitlab.haskell.org/ghcup-metadata/ghcup-nightlies-0.0.7.yaml set ghc latest-nightly
    - name: Cache z3
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/z3-cache
        key: z3-${{ runner.os }}-4.8.17
    - name: Install z3
      run: |
          # Config version
          z3version="z3-4.8.17"
          z3distributiontype="x64-glibc-2.31"
          z3full="${z3version}-${z3distributiontype}"

          # Download and install
          mkdir -p ~/z3-cache
          if [ ! -f ~/z3-cache/${z3full}.zip ]; then
            curl -OL "https://github.com/Z3Prover/z3/releases/download/${z3version}/${z3full}.zip"
            cp "${z3full}.zip" ~/z3-cache/
          else
            cp ~/z3-cache/${z3full}.zip .
          fi
          unzip -o "${z3full}.zip"
          rm -f "${z3full}.zip"
          sudo cp "${z3full}/bin/libz3.a" /usr/local/lib
          sudo cp "${z3full}/bin/z3"      /usr/local/bin
          sudo cp "${z3full}/include/"/*  /usr/local/include
          rm -rf "${z3full}"
          z3 --version
    - name: Cache cabal
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cabal
        key: cabal-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('cabal.project.local') }}
        restore-keys: |
          cabal-${{ runner.os }}-
    - name: cabal update
      run: |
          curl https://ghc.gitlab.haskell.org/head.hackage/cabal.project | grep -v liquidhaskell-boot > cabal.project.local
          cabal update
    - name: cabal build and test
      run: |
          cabal test liquidhaskell-boot
          scripts/test/test_plugin.sh

  notify:
    name: Notify failed build
    needs: build
    if: failure() && github.event.pull_request == null
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: jayqi/failed-build-issue-action@v1
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title-template: Weekly build for GHC HEAD failed
          body-template: |
                The weekly build for GHC HEAD failed.
                Check the actions for details.
                ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly installs ghcup, z3, and updates cabal on every run (weekly schedule and PRs). The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern reports a 6% VM time reduction on free runners by caching dependency downloads. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable (weekly schedule), and cache inputs (ghcup metadata URL, z3 version, cabal.project.local) are stable. Adding actions/cache for ~/.ghcup, ~/z3-cache, and ~/.cabal preserves all build and test steps while avoiding redundant downloads and installations. No contraindications apply (no mutable/untrusted content, no existing cache).",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
